title: Cast Shadow
description: Raymarch a sphere on a floor and give it a hard shadow. The canvas runs from -1 to 1. Camera: ro = (0, 3.2, 4), looking at (0, 0.3, 0). Use ww = normalize(target - ro), uu = normalize(cross(ww, vec3(0, 1, 0))), vv = cross(uu, ww), and rd = normalize(uv.x * uu + uv.y * vv + 2.0 * ww). March up to 64 steps with t += d, hit when d < 0.001, give up when t > 40. The scene is the closer of a sphere (centre (0, 0.6, 0), radius 0.6) and the floor, whose distance is p.y. Take the normal from central differences with eps 0.001. Light direction l = normalize(vec3(-1.8, 2.2, 0.4)), diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0). For the shadow, start at p + n * 0.01, set t = 0.02 and march toward l for up to 32 steps: if the scene distance at start + l * t is below 0.001 the point is in shadow (shadow = 0.0), otherwise add d to t and stop when t > 8; with no hit, shadow = 1.0. The colour is albedo * (0.15 + 0.85 * diffuse * shadow). The albedo is red (0.85, 0.25, 0.20) where the sphere is closer than the floor, otherwise grey (0.80, 0.78, 0.72). A miss is (0.62, 0.76, 0.92).
hintText: A shadow is a second raymarch. Start just above the surface, aim at the light, and use the same marching loop. If it hits anything before it gets far away, the light is blocked. Step off the surface with n * 0.01 first, or the shadow ray hits the surface it started on.
